resources.string: See club events in your own calendar. Changes and cancelled events sync when your calendar app fetches updates. This is not immediate.

This link is personal and secret. Anyone with it can read the calendar. Share it only with your calendar provider. The link stops working when you leave the club, but previously downloaded information may remain. Remove the subscription in your calendar then.
Google Calendar: copy the link. Open Google Calendar in a computer web browser and choose Other calendars → From URL. The calendar then syncs to your Android phone.
iPhone: open Calendar → Calendars → Add Calendar → Add Subscription Calendar and enter the link.
You have an active calendar link.
You have no active calendar link.
For your security, a previously created link cannot be shown again. A new link revokes your old one. Update the subscription in your calendar afterwards.
Link copied. Add it to your calendar.
The link changed on another device. Refresh its status and try again.
Could not manage the calendar link. Check your connection and membership, then try again.
